 For returns filed without payments, mail your completed return to:                                        To make an online payment, scan the
        Comptroller of Maryland                                                                            QR code below and follow instructions,

        110 Carroll Street                                                                                           and click on Pay.
        Annapolis, MD 21411-0001
 For returns filed with payments, attach your check or money order to Form PV.
 Make your check or money order payable to Comptroller of Maryland. If filing indi-
 vidually, you must include the taxpayer’s Social Security number (SSN)/Individual
 Taxpayer Identification number (ITIN) on the check or money order. If filing jointly,
 you must include the Social Security number/ITIN of the primary taxpayer, tax
 year, and tax type on the check or money order. Failure to include this information
 will delay the processing of your payment. Do not staple Form PV or check/money
 order to Form 502. Place Form PV with attached check or money order on TOP of
 Form 502 and mail to:
         Comptroller of Maryland
         Payment Processing
         PO Box 8888
         Annapolis, MD 21401-8888
